snippet_primary: "Shopify users own the customer experience. You have full control over the look and feel of your store, with customizable no-code store designs. Your store features and back office tools offer advanced functionality, thanks to thousands of tailor-made apps for product sourcing, subscriptions, dropshipping, and more. Etsy's transaction fee of 6.5% per sale can affect your profits. Keep more revenue from your sales with Shopify's competitive pricing and lower transaction fees."
